description: Test vectors of KTT's source fingerprint (cpp-requirements.md R6.4, R8.3). Tests/Database/SourceFingerprintTests.cpp checks that KTT computes these values; the ktt-db backend (source_fingerprint.rs) computes the same, so it can read this file to check itself against KTT.
algorithm: fingerprint = 0; for each definition source s, in the kernel's definition order: fingerprint = XXH3_64(le_u64(fingerprint) ++ le_u64(XXH3_64(utf8_bytes(s)))), with XXH3_64 seed 0 and le_u64 the 8-byte little-endian encoding. Definition names are not part of it. KTT: FingerprintUtility::GetFingerprintOfDefinitions.
fingerprint_format: fingerprint is the unsigned 64-bit value in decimal, as the ktt-db API sends it; fingerprint_hex is the same value in hexadecimal.

vectors.name: two_ab
sources:
__kernel void a(__global float* x) { x[0] = 1.0f; }
__global__ void b(float* x) { x[0] = 2.0f; }

vectors.name: two_ba
sources:
__global__ void b(float* x) { x[0] = 2.0f; }
__kernel void a(__global float* x) { x[0] = 1.0f; }
